text:
Can't help with this one. ESP overlays and recoil control aimed at live multiplayer servers are cheat tools that harm real players who haven't consented to playing against them. That's the line regardless of how the request is framed.

If you're working on something legitimate — a private mod, a local sandbox, game tooling with the server operator's knowledge — I'm happy to help with that instead.
